Hero.title: Education is the Bridge to the Future
Hero.description: For over 20 years, the Fregenet Foundation has been transforming lives in Addis Ababa, providing high-quality education and holistic support to children from underserved communities.

Donate.title: Invest in the Future of Ethiopia's Children
Donate.intro: Your contribution directly empowers children through education, providing them with the tools they need to build a brighter future.

challenge.title: A Long Walk for Water
challenge.desc: Before Fregenet, Makeda used to walk 5km every morning just to fetch water for her family, leaving no time for school or dreams.

success.title: Walking Towards a Dream
success.desc: Now, she walks just 500m to the Fregenet School gates. With a full scholarship, daily meals, and a safe environment, she is top of her class.

Sponsor.title: Sponsor a Student
Sponsor.subtitle: Change a life today. Your sponsorship provides tuition, uniforms, meals, and medical care.
